name: Ballinafid
agent: Gary Corroon, Sherry FitzGerald Davitt & Davitt, Mullingar
questions: No floor area is given; summing the room list we get about 300 m² (including the 7.4 × 10.6 m conservatory, excluding walls and the balcony). What is the measured floor area, and what are the BER number and kWh/m²/yr figure behind the B1?

The features say 'Option to purchase 5.5/ 9acre site'. Is the €795,000 for the house on about 9 acres, or on 5.5 acres with the rest optional, and at what price? Can you send the folio map, and is the woodland fenced enough for two dogs?

The only bathrooms we can see are the four en-suites and the main bathroom, all upstairs. Is there a WC or shower on the ground floor near the downstairs bedroom, and has anyone priced or sought planning to add one (for example off the 2.1 × 4.9 m utility)?

How far is the house from the N4 carriageway, how loud is the traffic in the garden and bedrooms, and is the entrance directly onto the N4 or onto a local road? How often do you hear trains on the Sligo line, about 300 m away?

Is the water supply mains, a group scheme or a private well? When was the septic tank/treatment plant last serviced, and has the house been tested for radon? It has been listed since September 2025 at €795,000; is the vendor open to offers?

ai.why: A handsome 1830s stone house, extended in 2006, on about 9 acres of woodland 8 minutes from Mullingar's all-ages ED, schools and Dublin trains: about 300 m², five bedrooms, five bathrooms, BER B1. Held back by the €795k price (about €2,650/m²), the N4 about 100 m from the house, and a ground-floor bedroom with no ground-floor bathroom.

electricity.detail: Likely connected; not stated, but the house is lived in and runs an air-to-water heat pump.

water.detail: Not stated in the listing; could be mains, a group water scheme or a private well. Ask.

sewer.detail: Septic tank/treatment plant, stated in the features. Ask its age and service history.

internet.detail: Not stated in the listing and no Eircode is published to check BuyerIQ or NBI's map. The area was in NBI's rollout (amber) zone in 2021; fibre is likely by now but unconfirmed.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: One: the 'Downstairs Bedroom' (3.71 × 3.31 m, laminate floor, built-in wardrobes); the room list shows no ground-floor WC or shower, so the parents would climb the stairs to a bathroom until one is added.

bedsNote: One bedroom (3.71 × 3.31 m) on the ground floor; four upstairs, each with an en-suite (primary 4.92 × 4.45 m with jacuzzi and balcony access)
heating: Oil-fired central heating with an air-to-water heat pump, plus a solid-fuel stove in the sitting room
tagline: An 1830s cut-stone house, extended in 2006 to about 300 m², on roughly 9 acres of woodland beside the N4 about 3 km south of Multyfarnham and 8 minutes from Mullingar.

pros.detail: Stated as approximately 9 acres (about 3.6 ha) of woodland and paddock, with a stone-and-slate garage; the features also mention an option on a 5.5-acre site, to be clarified.

pros.text: Room for six: about 300 m², five bathrooms
pros.detail: Room list sums to about 300 m²: four upstairs bedrooms of 18–23 m², each en-suite, plus a main bathroom, a 4.7 × 4.4 m sitting room, a 4.7 × 4.1 m dining room and a 7.4 × 10.6 m conservatory.
Regional Hospital Mullingar (24-hour ED with paediatrics) is roughly 7–9 km by road; the listing puts Mullingar 8 minutes away.
Mullingar station is about 10 km (roughly 12–15 minutes); Sligo-line trains reach Connolly in about 1h15, with about 8 a weekday.
Scoil Chruimín Naofa in Multyfarnham (222 pupils, mixed, non-DEIS) is about 3 km; St Finian's College in Mullingar, a mixed secondary with very high progression to third level, is about 10 km.
Cut-stone 1830s house with a double-height hall, timber sliding sashes and a solid-timber kitchen, renovated in 2006 to BER B1 with a heat pump alongside the oil.
Ballinafid Lake about 700 m and Lough Owel just south; Multyfarnham village, about 3 km, has a shop, two pubs and Weir's gastropub.

cons.detail: About €2,650/m² for roughly 300 m², with stamp duty about €7,950. On Daft since 12 Sep 2025 (about 410 days, 29,900 views) with no price change shown on Daft or MyHome: room to negotiate.

cons.text: The N4 is about 100 m away
cons.detail: OpenStreetMap puts the N4 Mullingar–Longford road (100 km/h) about 100 m from the house at its nearest and the Sligo railway about 300 m; expect traffic noise in the garden, and the woodland may sit between.

cons.text: No ground-floor bathroom for the parents
cons.detail: The downstairs bedroom is 3.71 × 3.31 m with built-ins, but all five bathrooms are upstairs; adding a shower room (perhaps off the 2.1 × 4.9 m utility) is a rough €15–25k.

cons.text: Most of the house is up the stairs
cons.detail: Four of five bedrooms and every bathroom are on the first floor, reached from a double-height hall.
The listing says 'approximately nine acres' but also 'Option to purchase 5.5/ 9acre site'; it isn't clear what the asking price buys.

cons.text: Water, broadband and floor area not stated
cons.detail: No water source, broadband, Eircode, kWh figure or floor area is published; the 300 m² is our sum of the room list. Septic tank/treatment plant and oil heating are stated.
Nine acres of trees means upkeep and fencing for the dogs; Ballinafid Lake is about 700 m away and the flood-zone check needs the Eircode.
